title: 0128 at a glance: one address per page
caption: One original for every page: a section's address and every other host lead back to it.

cards.title: One address per page
cards.text: Every page tells a search engine one original: its own route, on the site's own address.

cards.title: A section names its page
cards.text: /home/does answers the landing, and its canonical link is the landing's.

cards.title: The sitemap lists pages
cards.text: One address per page, never a section's, so it points only at originals.

cards.title: Other hosts are sent on
cards.text: A page on www answers a 301 to the site's address; files and the API stay.
